# Voltrix VX-15: Built for the Long Run

Marketing brochure supplied by Voltrix sales, 2026. Not a service document.

## Why VX-15
- 15 kW of quiet, efficient power for injection molding screw drives.
- Lifetime sealed bearings: no greasing, no downtime, no mess.
- Up to 20% lower lifetime maintenance cost than competing drives (Voltrix internal study).

## Built tough
- Class F insulation with extra margin.
- Runs cool in hot shops.

## Service you can count on
- Voltrix Express Parts: the VX15-BK bearing kit is in stock and ships in 2 days, anywhere in the US.
- 24/7 phone support.

## Ask your Voltrix representative
- Fleet pricing for three or more motors.
- Free motor health check for new customers.

Small print: claims refer to the VX-15 Plus with sealed-for-life bearings, available from Q3 2027.
Standard VX-15 motors follow the service manual.
